status: frozen before expanded v2 model output
purpose: Run every previously exposed v2 case once with the unchanged promising Gemma candidate; identify long-form, role, quantity, conditional, source-content and fragmentation failures before any unused validation.

candidate.native_renderer: gemma4 small, verified exact actual system/user output; no thinking trigger

request_profile.fragmentation: unchanged byte-bounded production fragments/batches, exact full-source reassembly and source-fragment order checked before and after calls
request_profile.native_sampling_defaults: unchanged model params temperature1/top_p0.95/top_k64; request temperature0 overrides

evaluation.labels: Historical holdout labels remain unchanged but all v2 inputs were exposed in earlier trials; this is not fresh heldout validation.

limits.memory_scope: Externally sampled concurrent supervisor/worker/owned Ollama/native process tree RSS, PSS also. Stop immediately on sampled budget or measurement failure; scans may miss transient peaks. No kernel hard-cap or whole-machine claim.

pre_request_checks: All original segment characters are reconstructed from the frozen production fragment sequence.
Actual request source entries must equal the next complete original fragments in order, with exact output schema and unchanged profile.
Actual Ollama render-only output must equal the pinned official Gemma4 small system/user format with complete request messages and no generated answer.
Actual owned native runner must use exact pinned blob path, four CPU threads and4096 context with no projector/draft.
Tokenize the full actual rendered request with the native loaded tokenizer; require one BOS and prompt tokens +2048 output +1 end reserve <=4096. No source clipping or smaller output budget.
After response, require normal stop, nonempty final content, empty reasoning, output below2048 and exact reported prompt-token count equal to preflight.

semantic_review.criteria: Every original v2 case-specific criterion plus unchanged global actor/name/number/unit/relationship/negation/uncertainty/action/condition/chronology/completeness requirements. Natural inflection/transliteration and locale decimal notation are judged semantically.
semantic_review.reviewer: independent package_verification agent; exact source/criteria snapshot frozen before output

stop_rules: First execution/structure/protocol/token-budget/resource/time/cleanup failure stops remaining requests and cases, preserving partial evidence.
One attempt per case; no repair, retry, glossary, source-specific replacement, alternate model, changed context/output or quantization.
Semantic failures are retained and reviewed; no tuning within this stage.

No summary or production-default changes. The unused v3 corpus stays unopened unless every v2 semantic/resource/protocol criterion passes; a separate unchanged-candidate plan and independent pre-output binding are required before that next stage.
coordination: Parent authorized this full12-case stage. ASR legacy diagnostic released the local inference slot; this screen is sequential and owns one daemon.
